examples.title: Basic flow
examples.description: Four nodes joined by edges: pan the canvas, zoom with the wheel or a pinch, drag a node, and draw a new edge from a handle.

examples.title: Custom nodes
examples.description: Each node type renders its own content from its typed data: a colour picker, a number input and a preview, with handles where each needs them.

examples.title: Workflow builder
examples.description: An automation editor: drag triggers, actions and conditions from the palette, wire them with typed ports the middleware validates, and configure the selected step.
